title: Hautefort (Jean de Bellièvre?) to Pomponne de Bellièvre, Grenoble, March 1584: Hautefort's Cipher, BnF fr. 15567 ff. 158-161 (and fr. 15568 ff. 207-209 in another hand)

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 15567 ff. 158r-161v (Gallica btv1b90639282, views 164-168; Source gallica.bnf.fr / BnF)

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlined decipherment of a few words on ff. 158, 160, 161 (Tomokiyo used it for his table); no full decipherment.

transcription.source: Claude (Opus 5.5) for Brice Dudout, 16 Nov 2026, from the Gallica images (Source gallica.bnf.fr / BnF): f. 158r ll. 1-20 one pass (f158/read1.txt); f. 161r ll. 1-14 and f. 160v ll. 1-15 two passes on different crops, reconciled on the image (f161/, f160/); f. 161v one pass (kept in the contributor's folder, not measured: 287 signs).
transcription.notes: Two blind portions measured (f. 161r ll. 1-14, 325 signs; f. 160v ll. 1-15, 330 signs), glossed signs removed; the rest of ff. 158v-161v is not fully transcribed. Folio corrections: catalogue 2839 is fr. 15567 ff. 158-161 (not fr. 15568); f. 162 is Maygnieulx's Cipher (Tomokiyo); catalogue 2841 runs to f. 209r, in another hand. Measured length given for f. 161r ll. 1-14; f. 160v ll. 1-15 adds 330 signs (f160/read_final.txt).

documents.route: unknown (Hautefort side per Tomokiyo) -> Pomponne de Bellièvre

transcription.source: ff. 207r, 208r, 208v, 209r: Claude Fable 5.2 (API run for Brice Dudout, 16 Nov 2026), one pass from Gallica crops (f207-209/transcription_fable.txt, sign codes f207-209/GLYPHS-hand2.md); f. 207v ll. 1-11: Claude (Opus 5.5), two passes after the key was frozen (f207v/).
transcription.notes: f. 207v was kept blind (never sent to Fable) and measured once. The training transcription is a single LLM pass (≈ 3,000 signs, 67 doubtful readings listed by the model).

system.summary: Tomokiyo's 'Hautefort's Cipher': a homophonic substitution of graphic signs (2-4 per frequent letter), a few code signs (12 = vous, 20 = nous, X° = par, B = que, 14/15/17 open) and nulls.
system.notes: Same cipher as the first hand (about 40 signs keep their value: Fable's sign map f207-209/SIGN-MAP.tsv), with hand-specific usage or corrections: c = l, G = a, th = i, v = qui; + mostly g (some e/m by sense); new signs ^! = g, O2 = m.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo's partial table only (cryptiana henryiii.htm); no reading printed

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout directed; transcription, key correction and reading by Claude under a preregistered single measurement. Second hand: key proposed by Claude Fable 5.2 (one API run), frozen and measured by Claude Opus.
tools: measure_main2.py (measure_v4 generalised to x|y values; 200 shuffled-key controls)

solution.what: Folio-to-view map checked; Hautefort letter = fr. 15567 ff. 158-161 (f. 162 is Maygnieulx's Cipher per Tomokiyo).
Tomokiyo's table corrected on f. 158r (∂ m/s by head shape, barred/plain q = e/t, ɷ = o, ſ = n); key frozen by SHA-256 with the PREREG.
Blind f. 161r ll. 1-14 (325 signs), PREREG v2 with thresholds set by the contributor (0.40, +0.20): 0.519 vs best shuffled 0.246. Passes those thresholds, NOT the programme's standard bar.
Blind f. 160v ll. 1-15 (330 signs), PREREG v3 at the programme's standard bar (>= 0.85 and >= best of 200 shuffled + 0.30): 0.787 vs 0.505. Failed.

Last fresh leaf f. 161v: PREREG v4 frozen (∂ = m|s resolved by the lexicon, same rule for controls), but only 287 measurable signs (< 300): not measured. No fresh portion of >= 300 signs is left in this hand.

Second hand (fr. 15568 ff. 207r, 208r, 208v, 209r): Opus failed (one pass of 18 lines, degenerate annealing); one Claude Fable 5.2 run transcribed the four pages and proposed key_hand2.json (first-hand table plus corrections). f. 207v never sent.

Blind f. 207v ll. 1-11 (318 signs), PREREG-main2.md at the programme's standard bar (>= 0.85 and >= best of 200 shuffled + 0.30), key and metric frozen by SHA-256 before the leaf was cropped: 0.879 vs 0.536. Passed.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's published partial table, corrected on f. 158r; NOT validated at the programme's standard bar (f. 160v 0.787 < 0.85); submitted as read in part by documented exception (DEROGATION.md, Brice Dudout, 16 Nov 2026).

gaps.detail: 15 precedes 'esdiguieres' (Lesdiguières) and '-e intelligence'; values not fixed.
The two ∂ forms (m, s) are not reliably separable at Gallica resolution; most probable words on f. 160v are m read for s.

gaps.item: fr. 15568 ff. 207-209: signs 14, 16, 7o, DD, g, &, *, line-1 nomenclator; + (g/e/m)
gaps.detail: Fable's conjecture * & = roi de Navarre does not fit f. 207v l. 8 (before 'Alexandre'); the crosses may be two or three shapes.

outcome.notes: Draft by Brice Dudout's session (Claude), 16 Nov 2026; reading review is the contributor's own, preliminary. Three blind tests: B 0.519 vs 0.246 (contributor's thresholds), C 0.787 vs 0.505 (fails standard bar), D not measurable (287 signs). Not validated at the standard bar; partial submission by documented exception (DEROGATION.md). Images: Source gallica.bnf.fr / BnF. Second hand: f. 207v passes the standard bar (0.879 vs 0.536, PREREG-main2.md); ff. 207r, 208r-209r are training material (single LLM pass), read only in Fable's unvalidated draft.

texts.summary: Hautefort reports from Grenoble on Lesdiguières' estrangement, suspicion of the Huguenots and the threat of Spain and the Duke of Savoy in Dauphiné.
